result.instructions: Tools for Finch, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which employees started in the last 30 days, and in which departments?"; "What were the total gross and net pay in our last three payroll runs?"; "Which employees are enrolled in our 401(k) deduction, and how much do they contribute?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Finch data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run finch_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run finch_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run finch_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. finch_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: finch_introspect
tools.title: Show the connection
tools.description: Show the Finch connection behind this access token: provider, products granted, connection status, and entity ids. Call it first to learn which entity_id to pass to other tools. Finch API: GET /introspect.

tools.name: finch_get_company
tools.title: Get company
tools.description: Read the company profile: legal name, entity type, EIN, primary contact, departments and locations. Finch API: GET /employer/company.

entity_id.description: Entity id (UUID). Required only when the connection has more than one entity; see finch_introspect.

tools.name: finch_list_providers
tools.title: List providers
tools.description: List the payroll and HR systems Finch supports, with the products and auth methods each one offers. Finch API: GET /providers.

tools.name: finch_list_directory
tools.title: List directory
tools.description: List employees in the company directory: ids, names, and employment status. Use the returned individual ids with finch_get_individuals and finch_get_employment. Finch API: GET /employer/directory.

entity_id.description: Entity id (UUID). Required only when the connection has more than one entity; see finch_introspect.

tools.name: finch_get_individuals
tools.title: Get individuals
tools.description: Read personal details (name, emails, phone, address, date of birth, gender) for up to 100 individuals. Does not return SSN or income. Finch API: POST /employer/individual (read only).

individual_ids.description: Finch individual ids (from finch_list_directory), up to 100 per call.

entity_id.description: Entity id (UUID). Required only when the connection has more than one entity; see finch_introspect.

tools.name: finch_get_employment
tools.title: Get employment
tools.description: Read job details for up to 100 individuals: job title, department, start and end dates, employment type, status, and manager. Finch API: POST /employer/employment (read only).

individual_ids.description: Finch individual ids (from finch_list_directory), up to 100 per call.

entity_id.description: Entity id (UUID). Required only when the connection has more than one entity; see finch_introspect.

tools.name: finch_list_payments
tools.title: List payments
tools.description: List payroll and contractor payments whose pay date falls between start_date and end_date (inclusive). Each payment has an id for finch_get_pay_statements. Finch API: GET /employer/payment.

entity_id.description: Entity id (UUID). Required only when the connection has more than one entity; see finch_introspect.

tools.name: finch_get_pay_statements
tools.title: Get pay statements
tools.description: Read the pay statements (per-person gross, net, taxes and deductions) for up to 10 payment ids from finch_list_payments. Finch API: POST /employer/pay-statement (read only).

payment_ids.description: Payment ids (UUIDs) from finch_list_payments, up to 10.

entity_id.description: Entity id (UUID). Required only when the connection has more than one entity; see finch_introspect.

tools.name: finch_list_pay_statement_items
tools.title: List pay statement items
tools.description: List the distinct pay statement item types the employer uses (earnings, taxes, deductions, contributions), optionally filtered by category, name or type. start_date/end_date filter by the date an item was LAST seen on a pay date, not by when it was paid: for historical payroll amounts use finch_list_payments and finch_get_pay_statements. Finch API: GET /employer/pay-statement-item.

entity_id.description: Entity id (UUID). Required only when the connection has more than one entity; see finch_introspect.

tools.name: finch_list_pay_groups
tools.title: List pay groups
tools.description: List the company's pay groups and their pay frequencies. Finch API: GET /employer/pay-groups.

entity_id.description: Entity id (UUID). Required only when the connection has more than one entity; see finch_introspect.

tools.name: finch_get_pay_group
tools.title: Get pay group
tools.description: Read one pay group by its id: name, pay frequencies and the ids of its member individuals (Finch returns no pay schedule). Finch API: GET /employer/pay-groups/{pay_group_id}.

pay_group_id.description: The Finch id of the pay group.

entity_id.description: Entity id (UUID). Required only when the connection has more than one entity; see finch_introspect.

tools.name: finch_list_deductions
tools.title: List deductions
tools.description: List the company-wide deductions and contributions (401k, HSA, FSA and similar). Each has an id for the other deduction tools. Finch API: GET /employer/benefits.

entity_id.description: Entity id (UUID). Required only when the connection has more than one entity; see finch_introspect.

tools.name: finch_get_deduction
tools.title: Get deduction
tools.description: Read one company-wide deduction or contribution: type, frequency, description and the company contribution rule. Finch API: GET /employer/benefits/{benefit_id}.

benefit_id.description: The Finch id of the deduction.

entity_id.description: Entity id (UUID). Required only when the connection has more than one entity; see finch_introspect.

tools.name: finch_list_enrolled_individuals
tools.title: List enrolled individuals
tools.description: List the individuals currently enrolled in one deduction, with their employee deduction and company contribution amounts. Finch API: GET /employer/benefits/{benefit_id}/enrolled (the ids), then GET /employer/benefits/{benefit_id}/individuals (their amounts).

benefit_id.description: The Finch id of the deduction.

entity_id.description: Entity id (UUID). Required only when the connection has more than one entity; see finch_introspect.

tools.name: finch_list_documents
tools.title: List documents
tools.description: List employee documents that Finch supports (currently W-4 tax withholding forms), optionally for certain individuals or document types. Beta in Finch. Finch API: GET /employer/documents.

individual_ids.description: Only documents for these individual ids.

entity_id.description: Entity id (UUID). Required only when the connection has more than one entity; see finch_introspect.

tools.name: finch_get_document
tools.title: Get document
tools.description: Read one company document by its id. Beta in Finch. Finch API: GET /employer/documents/{document_id}.

document_id.description: The Finch id of the document.

entity_id.description: Entity id (UUID). Required only when the connection has more than one entity; see finch_introspect.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Finch
prompts.description: What you can do with Finch here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: review_job_titles_departments_and_employment_status
prompts.title: Review job titles, departments and employment status
prompts.description: List the employees in the company directory. Then read the job title, department, start and end dates, status and manager of the people you choose.

prompts.name: review_payroll_totals_for_recent_pay_dates
prompts.title: Review payroll totals for recent pay dates
prompts.description: List the payments whose pay date falls in a period. Then read each pay statement for gross pay, net pay, taxes and deductions.

prompts.name: see_who_is_enrolled_in_a_401k_or_hsa_deduction
prompts.title: See who is enrolled in a 401k or HSA deduction
prompts.description: List the company deductions and contributions. Then see who is enrolled in one of them, with the employee and company amounts.

prompts.name: map_pay_groups_and_their_pay_frequencies
prompts.title: Map pay groups and their pay frequencies
prompts.description: List the pay groups with their pay frequencies. Then read one group to see the ids of the people in it.

prompts.name: confirm_the_finch_connection_and_company_profile
prompts.title: Confirm the Finch connection and company profile
prompts.description: Show the Finch connection, its products and its entity ids. Then read the company profile with departments and locations, and list the payroll and HR providers Finch supports.

prompts.name: read_w_4_tax_withholding_forms_beta
prompts.title: Read W-4 tax withholding forms (beta)
prompts.description: List the W-4 tax withholding forms that Finch supports, then open one document by its id. The Finch document endpoints are in beta and may change.
